title: Validation failures return 422 where the spec example cites 400
evidence: src/lib.rs:71 maps ApiError::Validation to StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY (422); R9 how_to_verify says 'rejected (400)'. Malformed-JSON still returns 400 (src/lib.rs:69).
suggestion: Acceptable REST semantics; if strict 400 conformance is desired, map Validation to StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST.
